transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today or what’s been on your mind lately?

I came in because most days I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. It’s like… I don’t feel like myself anymore. I used to be Ruben, the guy who could talk to anybody and get through the day fine, even enjoy it. Lately it feels like that part of me is just gone.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that activities you once liked feel pointless or uninteresting now?

Yes. I used to look forward to things like bowling, working in the garden, taking my wife to gallery shows, going dancing… stuff like that. Now I just don’t care. I end up sitting there and making excuses not to go, because none of it feels worth the effort anymore.
Have you been feeling tired or like you have no energy lately, even when you haven’t done anything physically or mentally exhausting?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I feel worn down a lot, but I haven’t paid close attention to whether it’s just tiredness or something else. It’s hard to tell.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth much or that you’re letting people down, even when there’s no real reason for it?

Yes. I keep thinking I’m useless now. Like all those years I spent taking care of clients and providing for my family don’t even matter anymore, because I can’t seem to handle this job like I used to. It makes me feel like I’m letting everyone down.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to focus or make decisions lately, like feeling more indecisive or having trouble concentrating on tasks?

I’m not sure. I can’t say I’ve really noticed that specifically. I mean, some days I probably stare at things longer than I should, but I don’t know if that’s trouble focusing or just me not feeling very motivated. Decisions… I haven’t really paid close attention to that.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately, like eating more or less than usual or losing or gaining weight without trying?
I haven’t really noticed, to be honest. I don’t think I’ve been tracking my appetite or my weight closely. Nothing stands out to me either way.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately, like having trouble falling asleep, waking up frequently during the night, or sleeping much more than usual even when you don’t feel tired?

Yes, my sleep’s been pretty bad. I’ll lie there at night going over work in my head, just staring at the ceiling. Then if I do fall asleep, I wake up around three or four in the morning feeling worn out already, and I just dread having to start the day.
Have you had times like this before, where you felt this way for a while, then it passed, and now you're experiencing it again?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of a clear time before where it was like this and then got better. Maybe I’ve had rough patches, but I don’t know if they were the same as what’s going on now.
How long have you been feeling this way now?
About eight months now, I think. It really started when the new regional manager came in and started coming down on me, taking away accounts I’d handled for years. Since then it’s just kind of stuck.

Looking back, have you ever had a period lasting at least a couple of weeks when you felt down or lost interest in things, and it was noticeable enough that others might have commented on it or affected your work or relationships?

I don’t know that I can point to a time like that before. I’ve had bad stretches, sure, but I can’t really say there was a couple weeks where it was this noticeable or where people were commenting on it. This feels different to me.

Looking back further, even before the issue with the regional manager, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row, maybe affecting your work or how you got along with others?

I really can’t think of one, no. Before all this, I had stressful times and days where I was worn down, but I don’t remember anything that lasted two weeks or more and affected work or people around me like this has.

Have you ever had a period in your life lasting at least two weeks where you felt down most of the time, lost interest in things you usually enjoy, or had trouble functioning at work or home because of how you were feeling — even before the issues with the regional manager began?
I don’t really have anything clear to point to before this. I’ve had normal rough patches, but not something that lasted like that or really got in the way the way things have now.

Have you ever experienced a time in your life when you felt down nearly every day, lost interest in things you usually care about, or had trouble functioning at work or home because of how you felt — and it lasted for at least two weeks in a row?

No, I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had rough times like anybody, but I can’t remember a stretch before this where I felt that way nearly every day for two weeks or more, or where it really messed with work or home.

Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row, to the point where it affected your work or how you got along with others?
Not that I can remember. I’ve had bad days and stressful stretches before, but nothing before this that went on like that for two weeks and really affected my work or getting along with people.

Looking back at your life before this current period, has there ever been a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for two weeks or more, to the point where it affected your work or how you got along with others?
No, not really. I’ve thought about it, and before this current period I don’t remember anything lasting two weeks or more where it affected my work or how I got along with people.
Since this current period started, have you had any times where you felt significantly better for at least a couple of months before feeling down or losing interest in things again?

No, not really. This has pretty much been going on for about eight months now, since the new regional manager started coming down on me and taking away accounts I’d handled for years. I haven’t had a couple months where I felt back to normal in between.
Before this current period started, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks, and then felt better for a while before it came back?
No, I don’t think so. I can’t remember any earlier time like that where it lasted a couple weeks, got better, and then came back. This feels like the first time it’s been like this.

Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down nearly every day or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row, even if it didn’t affect your work or relationships?
I’m not sure I can point to anything like that before this. I don’t really remember having two weeks straight where I was down nearly every day or lost interest like that.
